info.title: bizkit
info.description: The bizkit API. Every operation is also an MCP tool at /mcp when it runs in a workspace.

post.summary:
Sends a sign-in link if the email may sign in. Always 202, so the response
never says whether an account exists.

202.description: A link was sent if the email may sign in

204.description: Signed out; the session cookie is cleared

post.summary: Consumes a sign-in link and starts a session.

204.description: Signed in; the session cookie is set

401.description: The link is unknown, used or expired

get.summary: Show the signed-in user and their workspaces
List open invitations for your email

post.summary: Accept an invitation and join its workspace

get.summary: Show the bizkit version and enabled modules
List the workspaces you belong to

post.summary: Create a workspace; you become its first admin

slug.description: 2-48 of `a-z`, `0-9` and `-`, starting with a letter. Can't change later.

patch.summary: Rename a workspace; the slug never changes

get.summary: List the API keys of a workspace

post.summary: Create an API key; the token is shown once

expires_in_days.description: Days until the key expires; never when absent.

scopes.description: Scopes such as `projects:read`. You can only grant scopes you hold.

get.summary: List the forms of a workspace

post.summary: Create a form in a project

fields.description: The accepted fields. Default none, which keeps every field.

min_fill_ms.description: With `challenge`: the least ms between loading the challenge and submitting, 0-600000. Default 2000.

notify_emails.description: Who gets mail for each new submission, at most 10.

redirect_url.description: Where browsers go after a plain form post, http or https.

delete.summary: Delete a form and its submissions

fields.description: The accepted fields; empty keeps every field.

min_fill_ms.description: With `challenge`: the least ms between loading the challenge and submitting, 0-600000.

notify_emails.description: Who gets mail for each new submission, at most 10.

redirect_url.description: Where browsers go after a plain form post; `null` removes it.

get.summary: Export a form's submissions as CSV, newest first, at most 10000
List a form's submissions, newest first

oneOf.description: Only submissions older than this one, for the next page.

patch.summary: Move a submission to the inbox or to spam

get.summary: List pending invitations of a workspace

post.summary: Invite an email to a workspace; mails them a link

role.description: The role they get on accepting.

get.summary: List the members of a workspace

delete.summary: Remove a member from a workspace

get.summary: List the projects of a workspace

slug.description: 2-48 of `a-z`, `0-9` and `-`, unique in the workspace.

delete.summary: Delete a project and everything modules keep in it

post.description: Takes an `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` or `application/json` body of at most 64 KiB. JSON clients (a JSON body or an `Accept` naming JSON) get JSON; browser form posts get a redirect or an HTML page. Submissions that fail the bot check answer like accepted ones.

303.description: Taken: go to the form's redirect URL

400.description: The body is malformed or too large

404.description: No enabled form has this ID

get.summary: Get an ALTCHA challenge for a form

200.description: A challenge valid for one hour

404.description: No enabled challenge form has this ID

ApiKey.description: An API key. The secret is shown once, at creation.

oneOf.description: When it stops working, if ever.
When it was last used, to the hour.

prefix.description: The first characters of the token, to tell keys apart.

scopes.description: What the key may do, such as `projects:write`.

workspace_id.description: The workspace the key works in.

BotCheck.description: How a form tells people from bots.

challenge.description: The hex SHA-256 of `salt` followed by the secret number.

maxnumber.description: The secret number is at most this.

signature.description: The hex HMAC-SHA256 of `challenge` under the form's key.

CreatedApiKey.description: A new key and its token.

token.description: The bearer token, `bk_...`. Shown only now.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every non-2xx response.

fields.description: Problems per input field, keyed by path such as `items[2].name`.

label.description: A label for the UI and mail; the name when absent.

multiple.description: A `choice` field may take several values.

name.description:
The input's `name`: 1-64 of `a-z`, `A-Z`, `0-9`, `_` and `-`, not
starting with `_`, unique in the form.

options.description: The allowed values of a `choice` field, 1-50 of them.

required.description: At least one non-blank value is needed.

FieldKind.description: What a field holds, which decides how it is checked.

oneOf.description: Several values, such as checked boxes.

Form.description: A form that collects submissions from a site.

challenge_url.description: The URL the ALTCHA widget loads challenges from.

fields.description: The accepted fields. Empty means every field is kept.

id.description: The form ID, also its public address.

min_fill_ms.description: With `challenge`: the least time in ms between loading the challenge and submitting.

notify_emails.description: Who gets mail for each new submission.

redirect_url.description: Where browsers go after a plain form post. A thank-you page when absent.

id.description: The invitation ID; the invite link is `/invite/{id}`.

role.description: The role they get on accepting.

InvitationList.description: Pending invitations of a workspace, expired ones included.

memberships.description: Every workspace the user belongs to.

Membership.description: A workspace and the caller's role in it.

MembershipList.description: The workspaces the caller belongs to.

scope_areas.description: Every scope area API keys can be granted, sorted by name.

MyInvitation.description: An open invitation, as the invitee sees it.

invited_by.description: Who sent it, if they still have an account.

slug.description: The URL-safe name, unique in the workspace.

Role.description: A member's role in a workspace.

ScopeArea.description: An area API key scopes name, such as `projects`.

name.description: The area name; scopes are `<name>:read`, `:write` or `:admin`.

email.description: The email to send the link to.

next.description: A path in the app to return to after signing in, such as `/invite/...`.

Submission.description: What someone sent through a form.

referer.description: The page that sent it (`Referer`), at most 512 characters.

spam_reason.description: Why the bot check flagged it, if it did.

csv.description: The CSV text: a header row, then one row per submission, newest first.

truncated.description: True when more submissions exist than the export holds.

SubmissionList.description: A page of submissions, newest first.

oneOf.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; absent on the last page.

VerifyBody.description: Exchange a sign-in link's token for a session.

token.description: The `token` query parameter of the link.

Workspace.description: A workspace, the unit of tenancy.

slug.description: The URL-safe name, unique on the instance and immutable.

WorkspaceRef.description: A workspace's ID, slug and name.
